Policy i
TOD Value-Capture Tax
Levy a tax on residents & jobs near stations. Generates great revenue, but higher living costs displace transit-dependent riders.
🟢 Revenue 🔴 Ridership
Fare-Free Transit Program
Eliminate all passenger fares. Massive boost to transit mode share, but zeroes out farebox revenue.
🔴 Costly 🟢 Ridership
Congestion Pricing (Core)
Toll drivers entering Downtown zones. Pushes commuters to transit and generates daily revenue.
🟢 Revenue 🔵 Mode Shift
Deferred Maintenance
Cut track and station upkeep budgets by 50%. Saves money immediately, but trains will frequently break down or delay.
🟢 Savings 🔴 Reliability
Employer Transit Passes
Businesses subsidize commuting for their employees. Major ridership increase for trips into job-heavy areas, funded by an ongoing government subsidy cost.
🔴 Costly 🟢 Ridership Near Jobs
Transit Police Expansion i
Hire additional officers and safety personnel to patrol stations, ride trains, and respond to emergencies. Boosts ridership — especially evenings and at major downtown stations — and cuts delays from vandalism & trespassing, but salaries and 24/7 staffing add substantial daily cost.
🟢 Safety 🔴 Costly
Station-Level Pricing i
Set custom fares per station instead of one citywide rate. Stations you don't touch keep charging the standard fare.
